newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal non-EU trd deficit up, 44.4 bln esc Nov.
newsitem.headline: Portugal non-EU trd deficit up, 44.4 bln esc Nov.

text.p: Portugal's trade deficit with countries outside the European Union (EU) rose 24.8 percent month-on-month to 44.4 billion escudos in November 1996, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.
The trade deficit with these countries from January to November 1996 dropped 8.9 percent year-on-year to 501.0 billion escudos.

Between January and November 1996 Portugal imported from outside the EU 1,179.4 billion escudos of goods and services, up 0.1 percent year-on-year, and exported 678.4 billion escudos, up eight percent year-on-year.
